phase_zipf.ai_extension: SES PERF single-RD read adaptation; conditional Zipf within size classes; no added business lifecycle
phase_zipf.baseline: same business phases and layout with uniform selection within each group
phase_zipf.coverage: timed file requests, not complete scans; no guarantee of completed epoch, validation, checkpoint or inference
phase_zipf.scope: fixed ranks within business groups; preserve per-phase business group mass
phase_zipf.source_members: [original bin, zero-based original file index, rank within business group]; physical order unless fragmentation is present, then logical identity with fragments mapping

provenance.model_scope: Synthetic equal-byte edge fragments; not native graph encoding or measured trace.
provenance.write_mapping: Full-update template: active-edge load and writeback both execute as reads on the same bins, with logical volume doubled.
